name: Dexcom, Inc.
moat_justification: Duopoly CGM franchise with recurring disposable sensor revenue, pump/app integration switching costs, US leadership, and broad reimbursement coverage, held back by Abbott FreeStyle Libre as a close, larger, cheaper substitute, payer/CMS pricing power that can reset reimbursement, and product-quality/regulatory and leadership-transition exposure. Pricing power is real but contested, not structural — moderate-strong, not wide. CAP = 9.8 years.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 9 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
OE_VOLATILE: OE/share range over the last 5 yrs spans >3x — normalized base helps but the business is cyclical; widen bear weight
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2024, 2025 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base
BASE_DIVERGENCE: latest FY OE/share 2.26 vs 3-yr median 1.12 — one of them is distorted; find out which and why
WIDE_SCENARIO_SPREAD: super-bull IV is 4.6x super-bear IV — uncertainty is huge; confidence should not be high
one_liner: High-quality CGM duopolist, moat 6/10 — but at $83.985 it does not clear 15% on any defensible base (weighted IRR 9.96%, weighted IV@15% $46.68); it clears 15% only at or below $46.68.
moat_for: Recurring disposable sensor revenue — sensor replaced every 10–15 days, installed base re-buys continuously
Integration switching costs — iCGM pump, smartphone/watch, and clinician/caregiver data-sharing integrations
US CGM leadership and clinician/patient brand, with Medicare/Medicaid/commercial reimbursement coverage
Scale manufacturing and margin proof — G7 15-day efficiencies expanded Q2 2026 margins; H1 2026 FCF more than doubled
Expansion runway — Type 2 non-insulin (CONNECT trial), Stelo OTC, international growth up 19% in Q2 2026
moat_against: Abbott FreeStyle Libre — close substitute, larger global scale, aggressive lower-price strategy
Payer power — potential CMS competitive bidding / pricing pressure can reset reimbursement
Product quality and regulatory exposure — sensor recalls/adverse-event scrutiny; leadership transition
No owned distribution or payer channel — rents access through distributors, pharmacies, and payers
